name: Just a Simple Escort Mission!
source:
Bellamy Academy for Distinguished Service, or B.A.D.S for short, is an academy that dedicates itself to create elite personal protection agents for hire, essentially producing human shields for wealthy clients.

Loretta Cervone has spent her whole life preparing to be one of these agents, and she is almost ready to graduate. Before she can officially pass, she is required to do a (supposedly) easy mission alongside another classmate: to escort the eldest child of a wealthy family to a private institute, all while protecting them from those who are trying to kidnap them...

[From [url=https://naedoesgames.itch.io/just-a-simple-escort-mission]itch.io[/url]]
